contexts.text: He who is not in good feels a tediousness in thinking of such things.
A state of love, that it is devoid of tediousness. Signified, Explained.
When spiritual good and truth are in question, he feels a tediousness.
To him who is in a natural sphere... such things are tedious.
When such Spirits are applied to man, they induce great pain through a weariness which they insufflate... AC 5722. SE 4587.
Humiliation from weariness. Signified, Explained. AC 7392:2. Explained.
That the weariness ceased. Signified, Explained.
When they inflow... there is at once perceived a weariness in relation to those things which are of the Lord's Word...
When good Spirits are present (the evil Spirits) have to flee, because they are as it were killed with disgust...
An idle life... was in idea as it were a very sad and wearisome one.
(Adulterers) dwell solitary in deserts as the inertnesses and wearinesses of their own life.
